Chapter 6919: Debt Repaid

Chapter 6919: Debt Repaid

“Devouring Alliance is finished.” At the very least, they confirmed this with the new Stygian.

In just a short time, an unknown force swept through the alliance and most importantly, somehow brought back a dead world.

“The dark past is gone, Stygian will live again.” A primordial immortal peered through the barriers and sensed the new lifeforms.

Although the seedlings were weak, this was only the beginning. Darkness was no longer there to infect them.

“How, immortals couldn’t have done this.” Everyone was shocked.

Thus, immortals from the major worlds wanted to visit this new world to see what had happened. Unfortunately, this required trespassing through the barriers.

Doing so without permission meant declaring war against Guardian Alliance - something rather unwise.

Before the dao proliferation, perhaps some dared to do so. Now, the circumstances have changed dramatically.

Guardian seemed to be surpassing Heaven Assault at this point due to its upward trend. Thus, spectators quelled their curiosity and observed from a distance.

“Haha, incredible.” An old man inside Origination Enterprise had tears stream down his cheeks: “At least it’s over, it has been born. One wrong step led to a lifetime of mistakes. Now, I can finally put it behind me.”

He wanted to embrace this new world after such a long separation. Hope has finally returned.

“Who did it? And how?” Immortals couldn’t help asking these questions.

“Celestial immortals? Who else became one now? Empress Hong Tian and Eternal Sacred Teacher?” Another wondered.

Despite not having an exact answer, many determined it had to be someone from Guardian Alliance or several working together. Empress Hong Tian and Enlightener were prime suspects.

In a realm masterfully hidden, an immortal sighed and said: “The world’s heart was actually used, who did this?”

“Will Ruin make a return as well?” Another said sentimentally.

The major worlds were massive, enough to contain all the other minor worlds. Destruction throughout the epochs couldn’t destroy them.

Alas, immortals were truly amazing. Two have been destroyed - Stygian and Ruin.

Stygian fell to devouring, a process lasting epochs. However, Ruin’s fall only took one battle - Heaven Pit.

Heavenfall and Dusk gathered more than a hundred immortals to prepare a trap against the high heaven. This ended with the prosperous world being ravaged by countless tribulations. Could Ruin be revived in the same manner?

***

Li Qiye returned to Origination Enterprise, greeted by the old man.

“I don’t know how to repay you.” The latter kneeled - a display of ceremony unavailable to anyone else.

“It’s just karma, I have carried out my promise. We do not owe each other from now on.” Li Qiye shook his head.

“Yes, yes.” The old man nodded and dragged Li Qiye over for tea.

“You can sever karma and become a celestial immortal now.” Li Qiye sipped his cup and said.

“It doesn’t really matter to me anymore.” The old man said: “At the very least, I can rest in peace now after contributing a little to amend my mistake.”

“It was a great investment.” Li Qiye smiled.
